name: copy-uses-warm-step-cache-route-by-log
body: Step 2 reaches the cached-fact reassembly by an uncommitted spec-only node file under apg/layers/ (kept db.lbug, so the delta dispatch runs, the splice guard refuses the unrepresented authored row and the pipeline re-assembles the full graph through ingest_with_reuse and splice_cached) while the cobol frontend logs `no changed targets — frontend skipped (facts reused)` and never spawns, so both kind=copy edges can come only from splice_cached's restore of cached FragEdge properties; with that restore removed the edges vanish and the test fails. The trigger rests on git status reporting the untracked node file as a changed target, the same trigger the netbeans-scale acceptance test uses. Upgrade by switching to a committed authored change or another seed-fallback trigger if untracked apg/layers files stop counting as delta targets.
